notes.page_account: This continuation asks how the six usual operations on sheaves, on X or a union of its strata, are to be expressed in the proposed dictionary and how their known formulas can be checked again. It flags difficulty with dualizing complexes when strata are singular. It then suggests first considering a category of diagrams of semisimplicial sets and only afterwards passing to a homotopy category of fractions. A new indented paragraph reports recent thinking on foundations of topologie modérée, describes eliminating wild phenomena, and begins the assertion that an equisingular stratification of a compact tame space canonically gives a diagram of spaces. That assertion continues beyond this page; no continuation is supplied.
